title: Conditional What-If Generation for Radio Access Network Energy under Rare and Unseen Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2611.24208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Energy-saving mechanisms in RANs must balance energy reduction and network performance under varying traffic conditions. Conditional generative models support what-if analysis by generating plausible power-consumption trajectories for radio configurations and operating scenarios, helping operators evaluate energy-saving policies before deployment. However, representative measurements are costly and operationally constrained, so historical data cover only limited configurations and conditions, leaving some contexts poorly represented or unseen during training. In this paper, we study conditional generation of RAN power-consumption trajectories under decreasing training coverage, from well-represented to rare and unseen configurations. We first introduce a context-normalized conditional generator combining temporally aligned conditioning with configuration-dependent target normalization. translated_title: 面向罕见与未见情境的无线接入网能耗条件式What-If生成
translated_abstract: 无线接入网（RAN）中的节能机制必须在变化的流量条件下平衡能耗降低与网络性能。条件生成模型可以通过为无线配置和运行场景生成合理的功耗轨迹来支持“假设分析”，帮助运营商在部署前评估节能策略。然而，具有代表性的测量成本高昂且受运营限制，因此历史数据仅覆盖有限的配置和条件，导致某些情境在训练中代表性不足或从未出现。本文研究了在训练覆盖率递减条件下RAN功耗轨迹的条件生成问题，涵盖从充分表征到罕见及未见配置的情形。我们首先提出了一种上下文归一化的条件生成器，将时间对齐的条件输入与依赖配置的目标归一化相结合。它改进了对充分表征配置的生成效果（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出一种上下文归一化的条件生成模型，即使在训练数据覆盖不足、罕见甚至未见的配置情境下，也能生成无线接入网功耗轨迹，从而支持节能策略部署前的假设分析。
en_tdlr: A context-normalized conditional generative model is proposed to generate RAN power-consumption trajectories even for rare and unseen configurations, enabling what-if analysis of energy-saving policies before deployment.
